title: 第3章 九色神莲经！
content_zh:
秦政看到这几个字，几乎是低吼出来的。

他没有武脉，始终受到限制，是他最大的问题，而这九色神莲经修炼居然不需要依靠武脉，怎不让秦政激动。

神武大陆公认有三大武经，分别是九色神莲经，九转回龙经和九死涅磐经。

传说这三大武经任得其一，只要修炼至巅峰，便可打破人与神之间的禁锢，成为与日月同在的神。

而且后世所有的武经，武典等距都是从这三大武经之中取其一点精华形成的，可以说这三大武经就是最高级的，绝对没有超越的。

“欲修九色神莲经，需气血旺盛。”

接下来则是一段注解，秦政一看，是老东海王留下的。

大体的意思是，九色神莲经修炼，所需气血旺盛要求极其惊人，至少老东海王没达到资格，所以强行修炼的结果就是，以其威震神武大陆的实力，本可有三五百年寿命的，却仅仅活了不足一百二十岁，就因为气血亏空而亡。

“原来老王爷是因为百岁之后强行修炼九色神莲经而亡的。”

“怨不得老王爷未曾传给任何人九色神莲经，而是将其刻录在这里，以老王爷在年轻时便号称武学奇才，且被人评为血气旺盛，即便武道成就不高，寿命也可超越三百载，有望成为寿命最长之人，却因修炼九色神莲经，仅仅活了一百二十岁。”

因他是陪伴老东海王生命中最后的十年，平时老东海王也向他诉说一些曾经的往事，甚至在最后半年意识模糊，说出了许多估计连当今东海王都不知道的秘辛，故而秦政最是清楚，老东海王血气之盛，估计没几个人能够与之媲美的，连他都达不到资格，还有谁能达到？

“修炼九色神莲经，方知天地奥妙，自创是否可修九色神莲经的验证之法，滴一滴精血入石桌，若字体转化为神莲，则可修，无奈，王府上下无人能满足要求。”

看到这里，秦政才知道，老东海王早就暗中验证过王府中人是否可以修炼了，也就是说他秦政也被验证过。

“那也要试试，老东海王亡故都五年之久了，而我这三百次突破失败，洗练血脉，就是最近六年的事情，而且不久前才验证，血脉发生了质变。”

秦政想到滴血炼兵，金属水化人的一幕，他就对自己的血充满了期待。

方才只是普通的鲜血融入，显出这些字的。

没入石桌内，精血立刻扩散，迅速的蔓延，并且不断地淡化下去，汇聚在那一个个字的周围。

秦政屏住呼吸，眼睛直勾勾的盯着。

就见那些字轻轻地翻滚着，好像形成实体一样，石桌内不再是实心的，而是一个空间，且伴随着翻滚，每一个字的都开始发生微妙的变化，渐渐地字体分解开来，重新组合，赫然化作一朵朵的神莲。

秦政双手死死的抓住石桌，激动的差点要扬天咆哮了。

好在三百次苦修失败的磨砺，令他远比同龄人沉稳，忍住了欢喜的咆哮，他一屁股坐在地上，不断地用手在地上写着“静”字，足足写了三十多个才平静下来。

稳定心神之后，秦政重新站起，就看到那石桌上面的神莲已经重新回归字迹模样儿，并且开始淡化下去。

他马上便拿出纸笔，将九色神莲经给抄录下来。

完全抄录之后，待石桌上面的字迹重新消失，秦政也没有立刻将石桌拿出去，而是想办法弄了一些别人的血进行验证，结果发现，他们的血根本无法令字迹显现出来，很明显，能够滴血显出字迹，才有资格去验证是否能够字化神莲的。

如此秦政才真正放心的将石桌放回原来的地方，处理掉一切痕迹。

没第一时间修炼，而是要将其牢牢记在脑海中。

当确定背诵的滚瓜烂熟之后，他便将那纸给烧掉，如此才开始正式修炼九色神莲经，如此谨慎，也是铁盒子秘密居然会被人知道，给他的警示。

“以血脉沟通天地之力，洗练己身。”

秦政脑海中浮现出九色神莲经修炼之始的要求，整个人便沉寂下来，五心朝天，排除杂念，心与神合，用心去感应。

感应天地间流动着的最基本的力量……天地精气。

若能感应到，便可通过血脉，按照九色神莲经的要求，将其引导入血脉中，淬炼己身，便可以血为基础，凝聚九色神莲武脉，打破秦政没有武脉而无法突破境界的困境。

整个人都变得无比空灵的秦政有一种要飘然欲飞之感，更是有丝丝的气流在他的周围活跃着，好似微风，吹动的汗毛晃动，这种感觉极其的清晰，并且那丝丝的气流也缓慢的通过毛孔渗透进入身体。

秦政心头一喜，那感应顿时消失了。

他立刻平稳心神，再度去感应，有了第一次，这一次就更加容易了，很快便感应到天地精气与己身的联系，随即他便修炼九色神莲经基础篇。

渐渐地，那血就开始沸腾起来，并且流动加快。

不多久，血流声响起，如滚滚水流，后又若长江大河激流，最后化作海潮声，浓浓的血气在秦政周围浮现出来，涌动不停。

就见那周围浮现的浓郁血气立刻翻滚汇聚起来，缓慢的化作一株神莲的模样儿。

那血气凝聚的神莲便融入他的身体，开始游走在全身各个部位。

每每走过一地方，那里就如同被硬生生打断了一次似得，疼的秦政几欲昏厥。

“昏过去了，中断修炼，就要重新来过，我要一次冲过去。”

他咬碎钢牙，坚持了足足一个小时，那血气神莲才算洗练全身完毕。

如此秦政就有一种脱胎换骨之感，仿佛全身的杂质，污垢都被炼化了个干净。

完成这一步，接下来就是最关键的一个环节了。

神莲吸纳精血，融入丹田，化为武脉！

九色神莲经的特色就是以血为基础，用血之精华熔炼成九色神莲武脉，种在丹田内。

“一鼓作气，今晚就熔血化神莲！”

全身的血液都沸腾了，发出猛烈地海潮声，那血气神莲进入丹田内，与中心盘踞着，而那滚滚而动的血液之中，丝丝的血中精华向丹田汇聚。

流逝一分血液精华，秦政的脸色就苍白一分。

这种修炼，也是一种自我损耗的过程。

唯有溶血化神莲为九色神莲武脉成功了，方能重新恢复，而血气旺盛达不到要求，就会亏损根本，难以恢复。

丝丝的血之精华融汇那血气神莲内，便让这看上去很虚幻的神莲逐步的凝实起来，九片莲花瓣也不再是单纯的血色，各有特色。

半小时之后，秦政的脸色苍白无一丝血色，他的呼吸也很轻很淡，仿佛随时随地都可能窒息一样。

那神莲也终于显现出九种不同的色彩。

秦政那张白纸色的脸上挤出一丝笑意，完成这一步，几乎就注定要成功了。

随着他一声低喝，就见那九色神莲释放出九色光线勾连丹田，与身体结合起来。

当两者完美的契合，不再有半点隔阂之后，秦政深吸一口气，双手拇指和食指在小腹部一按。

下一刻，那天地精气就好像被一股可怕的吸力拉扯一样，疯狂地没入九色神莲内，然后再有九色神莲内涌动出纯净的力量融入血脉之中，眼看着秦政那白纸般的脸上迅速的浮现一些血色，片刻之后，就恢复如初了。

随着九色神莲吸纳天地精气，秦政就再度体会到了之前三百次的感觉。
content_en:
Qin Zheng almost roared when he saw these words.

He has no martial arts and is always restricted, which is his biggest problem. However, the practice of the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra does not need to rely on martial arts. How can Qin Zheng not be excited?

The Shenwu Continent is recognized as having three major martial arts sutras, namely the Nine Colored Divine Lotus Sutra, the Nine Transformations of the Dragon Sutra and the Nine Deaths and Nirvana Sutra.

Legend has it that if one of these three martial arts can be practiced to its peak, one can break the shackles between humans and gods and become a god who coexists with the sun and the moon.

Moreover, all the martial arts scriptures and martial arts scriptures of later generations are formed from the essence of these three martial arts scriptures. It can be said that these three major martial arts scriptures are the highest level and absolutely cannot be surpassed.

"If you want to practice the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra, you need strong Qi and blood."

Next was an annotation. Qin Zheng took a look and found that it was left by the old King of Donghai.

The general meaning is that the cultivation of the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra requires extremely strong qi and blood. At least the old Donghai King did not meet the qualifications, so the result of the forced cultivation was that with the power of the Shenwu Continent, he could have a life span of three to five hundred years, but he only lived less than 120 years old and died due to depletion of qi and blood.

"It turns out that the old prince died because he forcibly practiced the Nine-Colored Lotus Sutra after he was a hundred years old."

"I can't blame the old prince for not passing on the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra to anyone, but instead burning it here. The old prince was known as a martial arts prodigy when he was young, and was rated as having strong blood. Even if his martial arts achievements are not high, his lifespan can exceed three hundred years, and he is expected to become the longest-lived person. However, because of practicing the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra, he only lived to be 120 years old."

Because he accompanied the old East China Sea King for the last ten years of his life, the old East China Sea King usually told him some past events. Even in the last half year, his consciousness was blurred, and he told many secrets that even the current East China Sea King probably didn't know. Therefore, Qin Zheng knew best. The old East China Sea King's blood and energy were probably not matched by many people. Even he couldn't meet the qualifications. Who else could?

"Practice the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra to know the mysteries of heaven and earth. Create your own method to verify whether the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra can be practiced. Drop a drop of blood into the stone table. If the font turns into a divine lotus, you can practice it. But no one in the palace can meet the requirements."

Seeing this, Qin Zheng knew that the old King of Donghai had secretly verified whether the people in the palace could practice cultivation, which meant that Qin Zheng had also been verified.

"Then I have to give it a try. It has been five years since the old King of East China Sea died in his hometown, and I have failed to break through three hundred times and refine my bloodline in the past six years. It was only verified not long ago that the bloodline has undergone a qualitative change."

Qin Zheng thought of the scene of blood refining weapons and metal hydrating people, and he was full of expectations for his own blood.

Just now, ordinary blood was blended in to reveal these words.

After being submerged into the stone table, the essence and blood immediately spread, spread rapidly, and continued to fade, gathering around the characters.

Qin Zheng held his breath and stared straight into his eyes.

The words were rolling gently, as if they were forming a solid body. The inside of the stone table was no longer solid, but a space. With the rolling, each word began to undergo subtle changes. Gradually, the fonts decomposed and regrouped, suddenly turning into blossoming divine lotuses.

Qin Zheng grabbed the stone table with both hands and almost roared to the sky with excitement.

Fortunately, the temper of three hundred failed penances made him much calmer than his peers. He suppressed the roar of joy. He sat down on the ground and kept writing the word "quiet" on the ground with his hands. He wrote more than thirty times before he calmed down.

After stabilizing his mind, Qin Zheng stood up again and saw that the divine lotus on the stone table had returned to the shape of handwriting and began to fade.

He immediately took out a pen and paper and copied down the Nine Colored Lotus Sutra.

After completely transcribing, when the writing on the stone table disappeared again, Qin Zheng did not take the stone table out immediately. Instead, he tried to get some other people's blood for verification. It turned out that their blood could not make the writing appear at all. Obviously, only those who can reveal the writing with blood are qualified to verify whether they can turn the divine lotus into writing.

In this way, Qin Zheng could truly rest assured that he could put the stone table back to its original place and remove all traces.

Don’t practice it immediately, but keep it firmly in your mind.

When he was sure that he had recited it thoroughly, he burned the paper and began to formally practice the Nine-Colored Lotus Sutra. Being so cautious was also a warning to him that the secret of the iron box would be known to others.

"Connect the power of heaven and earth with blood and refine your body."

The requirements for the beginning of the practice of the Nine-Colored Lotus Sutra appeared in Qin Zheng's mind, and his whole body became silent. His five hearts were raised to the sky, eliminating distracting thoughts, uniting his heart with his spirit, and sensing with his heart.

Sensing the most basic force flowing between heaven and earth...the essence of heaven and earth.

If it can be sensed, it can be guided into the blood through the blood according to the requirements of the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra, and by tempering one's body, the blood can be used as the basis to condense the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus's martial veins, breaking Qin Zheng's dilemma of being unable to break through without martial arts.

Qin Zheng, whose whole body had become extremely ethereal, felt as if he was about to fly away. There was even a slight flow of air active around him, like a breeze, causing the hairs to sway. This feeling was extremely clear, and the slightest flow of air slowly penetrated into the body through the pores.

Qin Zheng felt happy, and the feeling disappeared immediately.

He immediately stabilized his mind and tried to sense it again. After the first time, it was easier this time. He quickly sensed the connection between the essence of heaven and earth and his own body, and then he began to practice the basic chapter of the Nine-Colored Lotus Sutra.

Gradually, the blood began to boil and flow faster.

Not long after, the sound of blood flow sounded, like rolling water, then like the rapids of the Yangtze River, and finally turned into the sound of ocean tides. Thick blood energy emerged around Qin Zheng, surging non-stop.

The rich blood energy that appeared around him immediately rolled together and slowly transformed into a divine lotus.

The divine lotus condensed with blood and energy merged into his body and began to swim in various parts of his body.

Every time he walked past a place, it felt as if he had been interrupted abruptly, and Qin Zheng almost fainted from the pain.

"If you pass out and stop practicing, you have to start over again. I want to rush through it all at once."

He gritted his steel teeth and persisted for a full hour before the blood and energy divine lotus was completely refined throughout his body.

In this way, Qin Zheng felt as if he had been reborn, as if all the impurities and dirt in his body had been refined and cleansed.

After completing this step, the next step is the most critical step.

The divine lotus absorbs the essence and blood, blends into the dantian, and turns into martial veins!

The characteristic of the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra is that it is based on blood, and the essence of the blood is melted into the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Martial Vein, which is planted in the Dantian.

"With one go, the blood will turn into a divine lotus tonight!"

The blood all over the body boiled, making a violent tidal sound. The bloody divine lotus entered the Dantian and entangled itself in the center. In the rolling blood, the essence of the blood gathered towards the Dantian.

Qin Zheng's face turned pale as every bit of blood essence passed away.

This kind of cultivation is also a process of self-depletion.

Only by successfully dissolving the blood and transforming the divine lotus into the nine-color divine lotus martial veins can it be restored. However, if the blood energy is not strong enough to meet the requirements, the foundation will be lost and it will be difficult to recover.

The essence of blood is integrated into the blood divine lotus, which gradually solidifies the seemingly illusory divine lotus. The nine lotus petals are no longer pure blood color, each with its own characteristics.

Half an hour later, Qin Zheng's face was pale and without a trace of blood, and his breathing was very light and light, as if he might suffocate anytime and anywhere.

The sacred lotus finally showed nine different colors.

A smile appeared on Qin Zheng's white face. After completing this step, he was almost destined to succeed.

As he shouted, the nine-color divine lotus released nine-color light that connected to the Dantian and combined with the body.

When the two fit together perfectly and there was no longer any barrier, Qin Zheng took a deep breath and pressed his thumb and index finger on his lower abdomen.

The next moment, the essence of that day seemed to be pulled by a terrible suction force, and sank crazily into the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus. Then, pure power surged out of the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus and merged into the blood. Qin Zheng saw some blood quickly appear on his white face, and after a while, it returned to its original state.

As the nine-color divine lotus absorbed the essence of heaven and earth, Qin Zheng once again experienced the feeling he had experienced three hundred times before.
